name: Priestess Alathea
summary: Within Darnassus, Priestess Alathea guides night elf priests in the Temple of the Moon. Devoted to Elune, she teaches sacred rites and helps acolytes prepare for healing, protection, and celestial magic.

sections.title: Devotion in the Temple of the Moon
sections.body: Priestess Alathea teaches and guides the Sisterhood of Elune within Darnassus's Temple of the Moon. After leaving Shadowglen, night elf initiates come to the temple to deepen their bond with the Goddess. Alathea shares sacred knowledge with those who devote themselves to healing, protection, and divine light.

sections.title: Blessings of the White Lady
sections.body: Night elf priests draw on Elune's grace, while human and dwarven priests follow the traditions of the Holy Light. Alathea teaches night elf blessings such as Stars of Elune and Elune's Grace. Under her guidance, acolytes learn to shape starlight into swift, protective shields against the dangers facing Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Priestess Alathea trains kaldorei priests in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, guiding acolytes through their sacred trials.
Alathea teaches standard priest spells and night elf trials, including Starshards and Elune's Grace, which channel the Moon Goddess's power and protection.

faq.q: Where can I find Priestess Alathea?
faq.answer: Priestess Alathea is on the ground floor of the Temple of the Moon in southern Darnassus, among the sanctuary's luminous waters and fellow priestesses.

faq.q: Why do night elf priests visit her specifically?
faq.answer: As kaldorei priests advance, novice instructors across Teldrassil send them to Alathea for rites such as Stars of Elune and Elune's Grace, marking their passage into mature service to the goddess.

faq.q: Does she train races other than night elves?
faq.answer: Yes. Any Alliance priest visiting Darnassus can learn general spells from Alathea, though she gives kaldorei racial trials only to night elves. Human and dwarven priests belong to the Church of the Holy Light.

faq.q: How does her faith differ from human and dwarven priests?
faq.answer: Priests in Stormwind and Ironforge invoke the Holy Light, while Alathea and her sisters worship Elune as a living deity. They wield starlight and moonlit wards alongside curative magic.

angles.text: As an Alliance priest in Darnassus, you can turn to Priestess Alathea for rank advancements and guidance in kaldorei celestial powers.
As a night elf, you find the Sisterhood of Elune's living traditions in Priestess Alathea, within Darnassus.
As an Alliance member who studies the clerical arts, you can learn at the Temple of the Moon from Priestess Alathea.
